teenKit.whyItMatters: Understanding how con artists hack human psychology protects you from scams by revealing how easily our brains mistake high-production-value environments for absolute truth.
keyTakeaways: Con artists use elaborate physical architecture, like rented storefronts outfitted with marble and actors, to completely bypass a target's natural skepticism.
Robert Greene's laws of power, such as appealing to self-interest and playing to fantasies, form the structural blueprint behind advanced social engineering.
